title: BattINFO Electrode Spec
description: A coated electrode as a designed artifact: active-material kind, coating composition, design values (loading, thicknesses, areal capacity), current collector and processing route. The 'spec' half of the electrode-spec + electrode pair; an electrode instance is a physical batch realizing this spec. The material spec describes the powder; the electrode spec describes the electrode.

schema_version.description: Version of the record schema this document conforms to (semantic versioning); stamped by the library on save.

name.description: Human-readable electrode name / designation (e.g. 'Si-Gr anode, aqueous', 'NMC811 cathode 96/2/2').

kind.description: Required Level-1 kind naming the ACTIVE material of this electrode, from the curated material-kind vocabulary (e.g. 'graphite', 'silicon_graphite', 'nmc811', 'lfp'). Required so a purchased electrode whose powder provenance is unknown is still queryable on the same aggregation axis as one built from an authored material-spec. Aliases resolve on input; an unknown kind is rejected at save time. See battinfo.electrodes.electrode_kind_keys().

polarity.description: Electrode polarity. Derived from the kind's family when not authored (active_cathode -> positive, active_anode -> negative).

grade.description: Producer grade / design version (e.g. 'v2', 'rev B'). Part of spec identity together with the producer and the electrode name.

active_material_spec_id.description: Optional canonical IRI of the material-spec for this electrode's active material, present when the powder is known and authored. Absent for a purchased electrode of known chemistry but unknown powder — 'kind' still carries the chemistry.

coating.description: Coating composition and coating-level design values. 'component.active_material / binder / additive' each carry a weight fraction under property.mass_fraction — the same shape a cell-spec's inline electrode coating uses, so a composition authored here is the composition a cell reads.

current_collector.description: Current-collector foil: material (name and/or material_spec_id) and its thickness under property.

tab.description: Electrode current-collector tab: material plus its dimensions (width, thickness, length, weld_width, tape_width) under property.

manufacturer.description: Producer of this electrode design — a vendor for a purchased electrode, or the lab that designed it for an in-house coating. Part of spec identity.

supplier.description: Supplier or vendor the item was sourced from.

product_id.description: Producer product / design identifier. Preferred over 'name' as the product half of the spec identity when present.

property.description: Electrode-level design values: areal loading ('loading'), dry and calendered coating thickness ('dry_thickness' / 'calendered_thickness'), nominal areal capacity ('areal_capacity'), porosity, diameter / width / length. An open snake_case map — new design values need no schema change.

provenance.description: Where the information in this record came from: source type, file or URL, citation, and retrieval time.

contributor.description: People who contributed this record to the platform (attribution/provenance). Each is a schema:Person; an ORCID may be given in same_as. Stamped by ws.save.

license.description: License under which this record is released, as an SPDX identifier (e.g. "cc-by-4.0") or a URL. Stamped from the workspace default (ws.license) and emitted as dcterms:license in JSON-LD.

ShortId.description: Short human-friendly identifier derived from the record IRI (Crockford base32, 6-16 characters).

UnixTime.description: Unix timestamp in whole seconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z.

Processing.description: How this electrode is made. Unlike a material lot's processing (an instance property — the same powder may or may not be carbon-coated), an electrode's route is part of the DESIGN: an aqueous-processed electrode is a different spec from an NMP-processed one, and the spec identity includes the route.

route.description: Processing route: water-based (aqueous), NMP solvent-based, solvent-free (dry), or other.

detail.description: Free-text processing detail (mixing, coating, drying, calendering, ...).

OrganizationIri.description: Canonical BattINFO IRI in the organization/ namespace (https://w3id.org/battinfo/organization/xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx).

id.description: Canonical BattINFO organization IRI linking this party to its organization record.

Organization.description: An organization referenced by name, with an optional canonical BattINFO organization IRI.

OrgRef.description: An organization, as either a plain name string or a structured Organization object that can carry a canonical organization IRI.

Funding.description: Funding project (grant) under which the record was produced. Maps to schema:funding / schema:Grant in JSON-LD.

source_type.description: Kind of source this record was created from.

source_name.description: Human-readable name of the source (document title, instrument, lab, or system).

source_file.description: Filename or path of the source file, when the record was derived from a file.

source_url.description: URL of the source document or landing page, when available.

citation.description: Resolvable citation target to use for attribution, typically a DOI URL.

citation_doi.description: DOI of the source publication (bare '10.xxxx/...' form). Prefer provenance.citation with a DOI resolver URL.

retrieved_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch, UTC) when the source was retrieved or the record was captured.

battinfo_version.description: Version of the battinfo library that wrote this record (semantic versioning); stamped on save.

Provenance.description: Where the information in this record came from: source type, file or URL, citation, and retrieval time.
